main.description: A selected public version of a thought. Published once, then immutable; retained until deliberately withdrawn, so readers can reach the version a citation engaged with. Local revision history is not public history — only the state at each release gets a record.

prev.description: The previous public revision; absent on the first.

changeNote.description: Author-reviewed explanation of what changed and why.

authorship.description: Who wrote the words. Ratification into the workspace precedes publication and is a separate act; this is an attributed claim about the workflow, not a cryptographic proof.

editedFromProposal.description: The human edited the agent's proposal before accepting it.
